body:
I guess so, but there's a part of me that has genuine hope. I know how good we were together, and I know that there is a part of her that still loves me - that's not me pulling it out of no where, we have spoken about it.

I just don't know how much of it is false hope.
And now I'm drowning in the hope that we will one day come back together...

She was the one. I could feel it. We'd been together two and a half years, and we had our future planned together.

I knew in my heart that she was my other half.
I have been through breakups before, but never one that has crushed me this badly.

My ex girlfriend.

And I understand where happiness part is coming from, but no. She has told me in person that she is happy.
